title: **Garantía Juvenil write path: three
notes: answers (step 4 occupation, step 5 interest and sector) are accepted while
the add-row sub-flows are not driven, so the command can reach
`confirmarInscripcion` without those rows: reject them before any write
unless the rows are verified in the draft. (2) `waitForYouthGuaranteeFile`
consumes a PIN or link already in the handoff file, so a stale code is
submitted at once after a new SMS: require the files to be absent before
the request and fresh after it, with an explicit flag for reusing a
still-valid code (the live run relied on reuse). (3) Any state other than
verified requests a new SMS or email, including a pending challenge after
an ambiguous response: require explicit resend intent. Fixed already:
pre-ticked checkboxes (consents) are no longer sent by default, after the
result: Row answers for step-4 occupation and step-5 interest/sector are refused before any write, and a required row field stops the command (rows cannot yet be verified in the draft); a new SMS or email needs --sms/--correo solicitar and a handoff file that is absent or empty before the request, while reutilizar submits the still-valid code or link without sending; any unverified or pending contact without intent stops at step 2 before any message.
evidence: pnpm check:ci exit 0 (2108 tests), including verifyYouthGuaranteeContacts.intent.test.ts, validateYouthGuaranteeRowFields.test.ts and the CLI flag tests; synthetic HTTP/file tests only, no request sent to SEPE.
